_doc: VARCO TextToSound(NC AI)로 효과음 전부 새로 만들기. 키 = 게임 효과음 이름(src/app/sfx-manifest.json). prompt = 400바이트 이하, n = 한 번에 받을 후보 수(1~5), len = 게임에서 쓸 길이(초, 생성은 늘 10초라 잘라 씀), vars = 무작위로 돌려 쓸 조각 수, loop = 반복 배경음. 생성: .github/workflows/varco-sfx.yml (GitHub 비밀값 VARCO_OPENAPI_KEY), 결과는 sfx-varco 브랜치. 첫 생성 2026-11-01

tap.prompt: Single short crisp UI button tap, soft glassy click with a tiny high sparkle, modern mobile game menu, dry, then silence

select.prompt: Single bright UI select confirm sound, two quick rising digital blips with a light chime, modern anime game menu, then silence

swap.prompt: Single quick UI swipe whoosh with a digital data shimmer, card sliding across a holographic screen, then silence

save.prompt: Single positive UI save confirmation, soft magical chime with a clean digital lock click, satisfying, then silence

error.prompt: Single short UI error buzz, two low muted digital beeps descending, not harsh, mobile game menu, then silence

coin.prompt: Single game currency gain sound, bright metallic coins and a sparkle chime, short and rewarding, then silence

open.prompt: Single UI panel pop-up open, soft airy swoosh with a light holographic pop, modern game menu window appearing, then silence

reveal.prompt: Gacha card reveal, magical crystal shimmer rising into a bright sparkling burst, anticipation then payoff, about two seconds, then silence
